optimizedContext.value:
# SDK Build Project Status Snapshot
## Rules
### buildProjectStatusSnapshot orchestration
- `buildProjectStatusSnapshot(ctx: SdkHostContext, options?: BuildProjectStatusSnapshotOptions): Promise<BuildProjectStatusSnapshotResult>`
  1. `ctx.kernel.project.getProjectSummary.execute()` — workspace/change/draft/discarded/archive + per-workspace spec counts
  2. If `options.includeGraph` true (default false): `withOpenGraphProvider(ctx, ...)`, `createGetGraphHealth()`, execute with `{ config, provider, codeGraphVersion, workspaces, assertUnlocked: false }` — config from `getConfig`, workspaces from `listWorkspaces`
  3. Merge summary + optional `graphHealth`/`hotspots`
- Graph fail (open/health/hotspots) → `graphHealth: null` (+ `hotspots: null` if requested); MUST NOT throw
- `includeGraph: false` → MUST NOT open provider

### Result shape stability
- `summary`: `GetProjectSummaryResult`
- `graphHealth`: `GetGraphHealthResult | null`
- `approvals`: `{ specEnabled; signoffEnabled }` from `getConfig`
- `llmOptimizedContext`: boolean from config
- Hotspots only if `includeHotspots` + graph loaded; else omit/null

### No presenter formatting
- Structured data only; text/json/toon in CLI presenters

### No direct repository bootstrap
- Summary/workspaces ONLY via `SdkHostContext` project queries
- MUST NOT construct `ChangeRepository`/`SpecRepository` or parallel bootstrap

## Constraints
- Cross-package read path lives in `@specd/sdk`; hosts treat null graph as unavailable
